headline: Sterling Financial Assets Cross N5 Trillion on Profit Growth
summary: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc reported total assets exceeding N5 trillion for the nine months ended September 2026, driven by a 37% increase in profit.
why: Asset expansion and profit growth at major financial institutions serve as key indicators of banking sector liquidity and credit expansion in regional African markets.

impacts.name: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc
impacts.why: A 37% profit increase and asset expansion past N5 trillion strengthen the company's financial position.
